page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-8-lssd is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance featuring 8 vCPUs and 62 GB of RAM, translating to 7.75 GB of memory per core. The underlying hardware is powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz. This configuration includes 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The CPU features a 504 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1D cache. It also includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations.

This instance comes bundled with a 402 GB local NVMe SSD, providing high-speed local storage directly attached to the hypervisor. In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong single-threaded performance, scoring 1899.0 in Geekbench single-core tests and achieving 35.4 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression. Text processing performance is particularly notable, reaching a top-tier score of 2924.0 in Geekbench. Multi-core performance is moderate, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 7155.0 and a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 9339.42.

Despite the high memory capacity of 62 GB, the Passmark memory score is relatively weak at 1720.0, though memory bandwidth for small cached blocks reaches 691.79 GB/sec. For database operations, the instance handles 14.89 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a Passmark database score of 3806.0. It also supports light machine learning tasks, processing 135M parameter LLM text generation at a strong rate of 283.92 tokens/sec. This hardware profile is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads, local database hosting, software compilation, and text-processing pipelines.
